description: Execute a specific action from the merchant's weekly plan (publish bundle, run mining job, archive rule, etc.). Idempotent by action_id, safe to retry. Use this AFTER the merchant has confirmed which action from get_weekly_plan they want to run; do not call preemptively. Merchant-ops surface: BigCommerce today; on other platforms merchants manage this from the admin, and the tool returns a clear not-available message.

action_id.description: The id of the action to execute, from get_weekly_plan.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Guard against accidental dispatch.

name: execute_weekly_plan_action
